description: Fix the real regression found by the morning run: S05d (publish-prepared-main.mjs) and S16 (worker-local-release-rotation.mjs, rework branch only) changed files pinned by tools/preparation-producer-qualification.mjs, so the admin resolution writer/validator rejects packets built from the current producer ('Unqualified preparation producer code', 6 failures in preparation-resolution, 6 in preparation-superseded-resolution), and the retirement fixtures that copy current repo bytes trip 'Fixture must pin actual reviewed producer bytes' (preparation-retirement-integration 1/1, preparation-retirement-collector 19/20). Re-qualify the new producer closures by APPENDING them (closures[0] stays the historical f641685b closure used by the a3d53227 case retirement), and make the retirement test fixtures read the frozen reviewed old producer bytes from a new fixture directory. Commit on the control branch first, then cherry-pick the identical commit onto the rework branch.
steps: Work only in the scratch repo D:\运营管理系统\.codex-tmp\rework-20261024\repo (git with $env:GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL='NUL' and -c safe.directory=*). Confirm branch heads: codex/release-rework-20261024=087a8348c0b2360267966e179054cd1c5e328dbf, codex/release-rework-20261024-control=d1b6049648bc6511431467f126c8e8f38ae8789a, clean status.

Review the producer diffs a6cc9fcd..087a8348 for tools/publish-prepared-main.mjs and tools/worker-local-release-rotation.mjs (and confirm tools/worker-local-release.mjs unchanged) and confirm: FAILED-<uuid>.json/FAILED.json bytes and shape unchanged, no new files written under the packet by these producer files, only in-memory error fields (S05d) and console timing lines (S16). Record this review in the feature findings. If any packet effect changed, STOP and set blocked (do not qualify).

Check out the control branch (git checkout codex/release-rework-20261024-control). Compute SHA256 of tools/publish-prepared-main.mjs, tools/worker-local-release-rotation.mjs, tools/worker-local-release.mjs on the control branch and on the rework branch (git cat-file blob <branch>:tools/<name> to a temp file, then Get-FileHash). Expected: ppm 86103124799a... on both, rotation b33b0b8b... on control and c90f6c9b5ce1... on rework, worker-local-release 6dcd3016... on both; use the full digests you compute.

Edit tools/preparation-producer-qualification.mjs (LF, keep the 2-line shape and the version string 'teruisi-cleaned-producer-qualification-v1'): keep closures[0] exactly as is (f641685b closure), append closure 2 = S05d-only producer (control branch bytes) and closure 3 = S05d+S16 producer (rework branch bytes), same three keys in the same key order. Update the line-1 comment to say: f641685b closure first (historical, used by case retirement); S05d (24dd52ac) and S05d+S16 (22193950) closures re-qualified 2026-10-24 because they only add in-memory error fields / stdout timing lines and leave FAILED bytes and packet effects unchanged; unknown code generations still fail closed. The file must be byte-identical on both branches.

Create tests/fixtures/reviewed-producer-f641685b/ with publish-prepared-main.mjs, worker-local-release-rotation.mjs, worker-local-release.mjs written byte-exactly from git cat-file blob a6cc9fcd:tools/<name> (use cmd /c "git ... cat-file blob a6cc9fcd:tools/<name> > <file>" or [IO.File]::WriteAllBytes; never PowerShell > or Set-Content). Verify SHA256 equals closures[0] pins e50f8112..., b33b0b8b..., 6dcd3016....

Add one line to .gitattributes next to the existing 'tests/fixtures/s05d-old-source-entry/*.mjs -text whitespace=cr-at-eol' line: 'tests/fixtures/reviewed-producer-f641685b/*.mjs -text whitespace=cr-at-eol'. Preserve the rest of .gitattributes byte-for-byte.

Edit tests/preparation-retirement-collector.test.mjs (around line 18, the loop over Object.keys(retirementProducerFiles)) and tests/helpers/preparation-retirement-fixture.mjs (around line 17, same loop): for files that are keys of producerQualification.closures[0] (i.e. 'tools/'+name), read the raw bytes from tests/fixtures/reviewed-producer-f641685b/<name> (resolve via new URL relative to the test/helper file, matching how s05d-old-source-entry fixtures are referenced); for all other keys keep reading from repositoryRoot. Keep the assertion 'Fixture must pin actual reviewed producer bytes' unchanged. Import producerQualification from tools/preparation-producer-qualification.mjs if needed, or derive the name set from retirementProducerFiles keys matching the three producer names. Both files use CRLF line endings and are -text: edit with a method that preserves CRLF on every line (e.g. read bytes, string replace on the exact substring, write bytes); verify afterwards that the only diff is the intended lines (git diff --stat and git diff should show no whole-file line-ending churn).

Do NOT change tools/preparation-retirement-qualification.mjs, tools/preparation-retirement-collector.mjs, tools/preparation-resolution.mjs or any producer file. Do NOT touch tests/preparation-resolution.test.mjs / tests/preparation-superseded-resolution.test.mjs (they must pass because the current producer is now qualified; this keeps the tripwire).

Search tools/ and tests/ for any other consumer that pins the old producer bytes or the hash of tools/preparation-producer-qualification.mjs (edfa4c30...) or assumes closures.length===1; report findings; fix only if a test in the morning list would break.

Verification in sandbox: node --check on changed .mjs; write a temporary in-process node script under %TEMP% (not in the repo) that imports the scratch repo's tools/preparation-producer-qualification.mjs and tools/preparation-retirement-qualification.mjs and asserts: closures[0] equals the f641685b closure; the current tools bytes of the checked-out branch are one of the closures; retirementProducerFiles tools/* entries equal closures[0]; fixture file hashes equal closures[0]. To run node tests create a temporary junction node_modules in the scratch repo -> D:\运营管理系统\.codex-tmp\rework-20261024\deps-8ec00f\node_modules (New-Item -ItemType Junction), run run-test.ps1 preparation-resolution preparation-superseded-resolution preparation-retirement-collector preparation-retirement-integration preparation-retirement-entry preparation-retirement-scope preparation-retirement-admission main-prebuild-queue-abandonment publish-prepared-main with -TimeoutSec 240; record which pass and which TIMEOUT (child processes), then remove the junction with cmd /c rmdir (never recursive). Optionally (read-only) run the inventory read against the production queue as described in context.json verification_instructions; never write there.

Commit on the control branch: message 'S05d: re-qualify S05d/S16 producer closures; pin reviewed producer bytes for retirement fixtures' (identity Codex <codex@openai.com>, -c user.name=Codex -c user.email=codex@openai.com). Then git checkout codex/release-rework-20261024 and git cherry-pick the new control commit (must apply cleanly; afterwards tools/preparation-producer-qualification.mjs, the fixture dir, .gitattributes and the two test files must be byte-identical between the two branch heads). Re-run the sandbox checks on the rework branch (the in-process script with rework bytes and the same run-test.ps1 list plus worker-preparation-timing).

End state: scratch repo on branch codex/release-rework-20261024, clean status, no node_modules junction. Record both new heads (full SHA), the new commit SHAs, and test results in this feature's findings. Confirm the control branch still does not contain c35de78e and that git diff --name-only <newControlHead> <newReworkHead> -- tools lists exactly tools/release-scope-plan.mjs and tools/worker-local-release-rotation.mjs.

Control branch head = old d1b60496 + 1 commit, rework head = old 087a8348 + cherry-pick; control does not contain c35de78e; tools delta between heads is exactly the 2 S08/S16 files

FAILED.json path (publicationStarted) unchanged. No new packet file. worker-local-release-rotation.mjs (S16 22193950, rework only): adds exported preparationTimingLine/logPreparationTiming/timePreparationStage that only console.log ([构建明细] stdout line, logger errors swallowed) and wraps existing awaits; each wrapper returns the same value and rethrows the same error (finally only logs), call order and return objects unchanged, no fs writes added. publish-prepared-main calls rotation in-process and does not capture console output into the packet. Conclusion: FAILED bytes/shape and packet effects unchanged, qualification is justified.
